question: Which specific files in Tempo and Thanos would need to migrate their Appender implementations and consumers to AppenderV2?

answer.summary: Prometheus has introduced AppenderV2 (defined in storage/interface_append.go) which consolidates Append(), AppendExemplar(), AppendHistogram(), Commit(), Rollback(), UpdateMetadata(), AppendCTZeroSample(), and AppendHistogramCTZeroSample() into a single unified Append(ref, ls, st, t, v, h, fh, opts) interface. Prometheus itself provides a LimitedAppenderV1 compatibility shim (AppenderV2AsLimitedV1) to aid migration. Both Tempo (metrics generator) and Thanos (receive path) would need to update their Appender implementations and consumers.

production_code.reason: Holds a storage.Appendable field (line 59) and defines the metric interface requiring collectMetrics(appender storage.Appender, timeMs int64) error (line 75). Must update Appendable to AppendableV2 and the metric interface signature from storage.Appender to storage.AppenderV2. The collectMetrics call at line 265 and the New() constructor (line 126) accepting storage.Appendable must also change.
Embeds storage.Appendable (line 32) and implements Appender(ctx) storage.Appender (line 141). Must migrate to AppendableV2/AppenderV2 interfaces.

collectMetrics(appender storage.Appender, timeMs int64) at line 127 must change signature to storage.AppenderV2 and update Append calls to the new consolidated Append(ref, ls, st, t, v, h, fh, opts) format.
collectMetrics(appender storage.Appender, timeMs int64) at line 177 must migrate to AppenderV2.
collectMetrics(appender storage.Appender, timeMs int64) at line 124 must migrate to AppenderV2.

collectMetrics(appender storage.Appender, timeMs int64) at line 212, nativeHistograms() at line 323, and classicHistograms() at line 424 all accept storage.Appender and must migrate to AppenderV2. These methods call Append(), AppendExemplar(), and AppendHistogram() separately which would become single unified Append() calls.

test_code.reason: Defines noopStorage.Appender() returning storage.Appender (line 453) and noopAppender struct (line 459) implementing the full V1 Appender interface (Append, AppendExemplar, AppendHistogram, Commit, Rollback, SetOptions, UpdateMetadata, AppendCTZeroSample, AppendHistogramCTZeroSample). Must be rewritten to implement AppenderV2 with the consolidated Append method.

Defines both noopAppender (line 14) and capturingAppender (line 53) implementing the full V1 Appender interface. Both assert storage.Appendable and storage.Appender compliance. Must migrate all method implementations to AppenderV2.
Extensively uses noopAppender and capturingAppender throughout tests. All test assertions and mock usage must be updated for AppenderV2.
Uses capturingAppender extensively (lines 477, 638, 683, 906, 918, 932, 955) and defines collectMetricsAndAssertSeries accepting storage.Appender (line 518).
Uses noopAppender and capturingAppender in tests (lines 231, 282).
Defines testCounter, testGauge, testHistogram with collectMetrics(_ storage.Appender, _ int64) signatures (lines 119, 162, 214). Must update to AppenderV2.

production_code.reason: Defines the Appendable interface with Appender(ctx) (storage.Appender, error) at line 25-26. Defines ReceiveAppender struct (line 34) that embeds storage.Appender and overrides Append() (line 40) with validation/logging. The Write() method obtains an Appender via s.Appender(ctx) at line 83 and calls app.Append() at line 123. All of these must migrate to AppenderV2/AppendableV2.

Implements TenantAppendable() returning Appendable (line 1011). ReadyStorage.Appender() returns (storage.Appender, error) at line 1111. The adapter type's Appender() at line 1145 wraps db.Appender(). All must migrate to AppenderV2.

Creates and uses the Writer (line 100, 129, 171). The receiveHTTP handler (line 508) and handleRequest (line 661) orchestrate writes that flow through the Writer which uses Appender. While handler.go doesn't directly call Appender methods, it passes the Writer which depends on the Appender interface, so its type references and instantiation must be updated.
The receiveOTLPHTTP handler (line 22) processes OTLP write requests and creates WriteRequests that flow through the same Writer/Appender path. Indirectly affected through the shared write pipeline.

test_code.reason: Tests the handler which uses the Writer/Appender pipeline. Mock implementations and test assertions would need updates for AppenderV2.
Tests TenantAppendable and Appender methods. Mock implementations must migrate to AppenderV2.

prometheus_reference_files.interface_definition: storage/interface_append.go - Defines AppendableV2, AppenderV2, AppendV2Options, AppendPartialError, LimitedAppenderV1 compatibility shim, and AppenderV2AsLimitedV1 helper.
prometheus_reference_files.migration_note: Prometheus provides LimitedAppenderV1 as a transitional interface and AppenderV2AsLimitedV1() wrapper to help downstream consumers migrate incrementally. The TODO comments indicate this shim will be removed once migration is fully complete.

answer.key_migration_pattern: The core change is replacing multiple separate method calls (Append for floats, AppendHistogram for histograms, AppendExemplar for exemplars, UpdateMetadata, AppendCTZeroSample, AppendHistogramCTZeroSample) with a single unified Append(ref SeriesRef, ls Labels, st int64, t int64, v float64, h *Histogram, fh *FloatHistogram, opts AppendV2Options) call. The opts parameter carries exemplar data, metadata, and CT zero sample information that were previously separate methods.
